removalCriteria: Progress should be reviewed at least annually on English proficiency and academic progress
A learner functioning at age and grade level commensurate with abilities may no longer need EAL
Monitoring is by the classroom teacher and, where available, the EAL teacher
The EAL Support Grant is funded for a maximum of four consecutive years
Leaving does not preclude the learner receiving EAL services again should the need arise
